test_access_rule: Run once after this protocol and the analysis script are committed; no tuning, reranking, feature selection, mapping selection or result-dependent code changes.

model.expression_shift_fit: Existing TCGA Train-only shifts from tcga_kirc_expression_bridge_v1
model.driver_rule: All five driver indicators fixed to their non-Kidney training means
model.ranking: Lower predicted residual among TCGA-covered non-common-essential genes
model.common_essential: DepMap release-wide annotation already frozen upstream

primary_endpoints: Primary-input Train-versus-Test selection-frequency Spearman among genes active in either cohort
Test per-patient primary-versus-sensitivity mapping Top-10 overlap and full-ranking Spearman
Frozen-20 paired Test tumor-minus-adjacent-normal medians and 20000-draw bootstrap intervals

reporting.reason: TCGA has no functional dependency labels; arbitrary agreement thresholds would not establish accuracy.
reporting.multiplicity_claim: Bootstrap intervals are descriptive and no gene-level confirmatory p-values are claimed.

bootstrap.unit: patient or paired patient as applicable

interpretation_ceiling: This Test analysis can confirm prediction stability and expression directions only. It cannot validate patient functional dependency, efficacy, toxicity or a therapeutic window.
